semantic_assessment: Read every source and target value against the context. Group/channel selector labels are natural and distinct. Name and Description/topic remain separate concepts. Help limits editing to name and description and visibility to conversation participants. Length limit and allowed line breaks/tabs are preserved. Invalid/forbidden/archived messages preserve their failure meaning and do not offer permission or reopen promises. Failed-save copy preserves the unsaved/draft/retry meaning without adding durability, automatic retry or atomic/partial-update guarantees. No translation broadens editing to membership, settings or access rights.

mechanical.placeholder_parity: kind/select and max/number preserved exactly by argument/type; group and other select arms in both selectors
mechanical.bidi_controls: none of LRM/RLM, embeddings, overrides or isolates found

limitations: Source-only semantic audit, not rendered or compiled-native proof.
No layout, truncation, font shaping or RTL rendering proof; no browser or full suite run.
Mechanical scanner is English-oriented and filters some ICU/single-token strings; all 70 target values were separately read semantically.
No backend partial-update, permission enforcement or draft-retention behavior was executed; evaluated translated claims against frozen English and context only.
